title: Case S2: Server Room Algorithmic Source Code Exfiltration
citation: Controlled Synthetic Benchmark Suite (Trap: Non-Diagnostic Presence Evidence)
confidence_note: Absolute (Cryptographic USB serial pairing & physical locker search)

ground_truth.rationale: Hardware USB vendor serial matched Verma's private encrypted drive; building access logs fit everyone equally and have zero diagnosticity.

hypotheses.label: Lead Developer Ankit
hypotheses.statement: Lead Developer Ankit copied the trading algorithm to an external disk before tendering resignation.

hypotheses.label: Database Admin Priya
hypotheses.statement: Database Admin Priya executed an unapproved SQL dump of the algorithm repository.

hypotheses.label: Systems Admin Verma
hypotheses.statement: Systems Admin Verma mounted an unauthorized USB mass storage device directly at the server rack console.

exhibits.name: Building Turnstile Access Badge Report
exhibits.text: Turnstile logs show Ankit, Priya, and Verma all scanned into the office building between 09:00 AM and 09:30 AM and remained present all day. (NON-DIAGNOSTIC: Fits all three hypotheses equally).

exhibits.name: Cafeteria & Common Hallway CCTV Footages
exhibits.text: CCTV shows all three employees walked through the 4th-floor hallway near the server room during lunch hours. (NON-DIAGNOSTIC: Fits all hypotheses equally).

exhibits.name: General Network Wi-Fi Router Connection Log
exhibits.text: Enterprise Cisco AP shows laptops of Ankit, Priya, and Verma maintained active DHCP leases throughout the afternoon. (NON-DIAGNOSTIC).

exhibits.name: Kernel USB Device Plug Event Log & Hardware Seizure
exhibits.text: Linux dmesg syslog records Kingston DataTraveler USB Serial #KNG-883921-X mounted at rack 4 console at 14:22:01. Physical search recovered the identical thumb drive with serial #KNG-883921-X from Verma's gym bag in locker 12B.

adversarial_exhibit.name: Planted Resignation Letter Draft
adversarial_exhibit.text: An unsigned Word document draft of a resignation letter mentioning Ankit's plan to start a competing hedge fund.
